Name: Retroactive Seasoning
Author: literaltree
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Lets you apply seasoning to food after it's already been cooked.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Compatible with my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52716]Qi Speed[/url][/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]New item: The Seasoning Board[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]If Love of Cooking is installed, it will have a custom unlock condition:[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unlocked from getting level 6 in cooking.[/color]
[/size]
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53389/53389-1791140002-894051408.png[/img][/spoiler]

[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Also works with Love of Cooking's simple and super seasoning.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Config Option for LoC Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Choose between either prioritising higher quality seasoning first or prioritising lower quality seasoning first.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the contents into your mods folder.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Source available on Codeberg:[/b][/size]
[url=https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/%5BCP%5D-Retroactive-Seasoning]https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/%5BCP%5D-Retroactive-Seasoning[/url]

Manifest.Name: Retroactive Seasoning
Manifest.Description: Adds a new kitchen machine for applying seasoning to cooked food.
